title: Fraction Class
hints: Because the constructor always reduces, every operator can just build a new `Fraction` from the raw formula and return it. `a += b` can then be `a = a + b; return a;`.
Compare fractions by cross-multiplying: `a < b` exactly when `a.num * b.den < b.num * a.den` (denominators are kept positive). For `<=>`, return `(a.m_num * b.m_den) <=> (b.m_num * a.m_den)`.
requirements: Always stored reduced, denominator positive, never zero
Test file with 15+ checks (use your tiny test harness from [[3.08 Halts goto and Testing Your Code]])
